title: Josh Hoover bloodied during first half of Indiana debut, stays in game to throw TD anyway
content:
Indiana transfer quarterback Josh Hoover started the 2026 season with a battered and bloody face. But you should see the other team.

A gnarly second-quarter facemask by North Texas defensive end Udoka Ezeani left the former TCU quarterback with blood pouring out of his nose and down his jersey. But the senior stayed in the game and threw a dart to wide receiver Charlie Becker for a 9-yard touchdown three plays later, giving the Hoosiers a 21-3 lead.

It’s been a fast start for Indiana head coach Curt Cignetti and the defending champs, who were up 24-6 on the Mean Green at the half.
